description: A Kotlin class implementing a fragment that displays and manages local files, including UI components for listing files, sharing options, and previews, with integration to Android system activities and custom transfer management.

classes.name: FilesFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays files, handles sharing, preview, and file selection via system picker.

classes.name: FileListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for RecyclerView to display list of FileItems with Share and Preview actions.

classes.name: FileViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder for file list item views.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of FilesFragment.

methods.name: startSystemPickerForShare
methods.description: Launches a system document picker to select files for sharing.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment UI and initializes components.

methods.name: showShareChooser
methods.description: Displays sharing options and handles user choice.

methods.name: requestBluetoothAndSend
methods.description: Requests Bluetooth permissions and initiates Bluetooth transfer.

methods.name: requestWifiAndSend
methods.description: Requests Wi-Fi Direct permissions and initiates Wi-Fi transfer.

methods.name: loadSample
methods.description: Loads sample file items into the list for display.

methods.name: Uri.toFileItem
methods.description: Converts a Uri into a FileItem object with metadata.
